name: Shia Kids TV
description: Dedicated Shia children's video channel with Islamic animations, Ahl al-Bayt stories, nasheeds, duas, poems and child-friendly learning videos.

name: Who Are the Shia? — 12 Imams | Shia Kids
description: A highly viewed child-oriented introduction to the Shia identity and the Twelve Imams. Use as an introductory resource and follow with age-appropriate discussion.
popularityNote: Popular channel video; current channel page lists it among its most-viewed videos.

name: Shia Kids TV — Duas & Poems Collection
description: Use the Shia Kids TV channel as a starting collection for child-friendly duas, poems, nasheeds and short faith-building videos.

name: Wilayat Ki Rail — Shia Kids TV
description: Urdu children's nasheed/video introducing Wilayat in a lively child-oriented format.

name: Isra wal Miraj — Bachon ke liye Islami Kahani
description: Urdu animated story of Isra wal Miraj presented specifically for children.

name: Isra wal Miraj for Kids — Shia Animation
description: English child-friendly animated presentation of Isra wal Miraj from a Shia perspective.

name: Imam Ali (AS) Poem for Kids — Little Hearts Love Ali
description: Short child-friendly poem/video focused on love for Imam Ali (AS). Suitable for a simple listen-and-repeat or discussion activity.

name: Shia Kalma for Kids — Kalma with Wilayat of Imam Ali (AS)
description: Child-oriented learning video about the Shia kalma and Wilayat of Imam Ali (AS). Best used with parent/teacher context rather than passive viewing only.

name: Call Imam Mahdi / Dars & Nasheeds — Shia Kids TV
description: A collection starting point for child-friendly Imam Mahdi (AJ) nasheeds, duas and learning videos.

name: Majlis-e-Aza Ki Barkatain — Shia Kids TV
description: Urdu child-oriented Muharram/Karbala series. Use selected episodes according to the child's age and emotional readiness.

name: Hujja Kids
description: Shia Islamic entertainment and educational platform for children with shows, storytelling, activities and games inspired by the Ahlul Bayt and Imam Mahdi.

name: Hujja Kids — Karbala / Muharram
description: A children's approach to connecting children with Imam Hussain, Karbala and Ahlul Bayt values through shows, stories and interactive activities.

name: Faraj Kids — Jawad & Maahira
description: Child-focused videos and nasheeds designed to make Quran and Ahlul Bayt learning engaging. Includes Urdu material and stories around Imam Hussain/Karbala.

name: Faraj Kids — Full Video Library
description: Browse the broader Faraj Kids video library rather than relying on a single episode. Useful for parents/teachers looking for a sequence of child-friendly content.

name: Arbaeen: A Lesson for Life — Children's Animated Movie
description: Animated family movie about Arbaeen, love, sacrifice, unity and service.

name: Nuh Ki Kashti — Animated Quran Story
description: Child-friendly animated telling of the Quranic story of Prophet Nuh (AS).

name: Alwasi TV — Children's Shows
description: Shia media platform offering children's shows alongside Quran, educational programs and cultural content. Language should be checked before assigning to younger Urdu-speaking learners.

name: Pearls of Light — Ahlul Bayt Animated Stories
description: Community-source playlist of gentle Ahlul Bayt and moral stories. Individual episodes should be checked before broad recommendation.

name: Kids 3–5: Start Here — Short Faith & Good-Habit Videos
description: A curated starting collection for very young children: prefer short videos, simple duas, good manners, Allah awareness, stories and songs. Parent should choose individual videos rather than giving unrestricted autoplay access.

name: Kids 6–8: Stories, Imams & Quran
description: A starting pathway combining stories, Twelve Imams, Quranic stories, Ahlul Bayt and short reflective activities.

name: Kids 9–12: Learn, Watch & Explain
description: For older children, choose slightly deeper stories and lessons, then add a simple task: explain one thing learned, ask one question or connect the lesson to a habit.
